name: DubThrow
description: Dub-desk send throw on the XY pad. Dry always passes; pad throw feeds a BPM-synced stereo delay with feedback-path bandpass. X = throw amount, Y = feedback tone. Release stops new input while the echo tail decays.

params.name: THROW
params.detail: Send / throw amount (left = nearly dry, right = full throw)

params.name: TONE
params.detail: Feedback bandpass cutoff (down = dark tail, up = bright / nasal)

params.name: DEPTH
params.detail: Overall wet ceiling and throw sensitivity

params.name: FDBK
params.detail: Feedback amount (high blooms toward self-oscillation; loop AGC avoids instant saturation)

params.name: SPRD
params.detail: L/R delay time spread (dub stereo offset)

params.name: TOUCH
params.detail: Gate (hold to throw), Latch (keep send), Always (X only)
